about_the_game:
This Demo contains the first section of the Game.

Come Join the Party!

Loud music is blaring from your neighbour's flat. All the while you're dead-tired, a little introverted and most importantly: not invited. So what are you to do?

Once you've finally convinced yourself to stop by, you'll find that partying like a pro is not quite as easy as you would have imagined.

Unique Party-Based Gameplay:

  • Meet a bunch of kooky characters: If you'll manage get a read on them, you might be able to hit it off and become friends.

  • Solve puzzles: More and more of the party will become accessible to you, as you help out some of the partygoers.

  • Plan out your actions: In this turn-based time progression system, deciding when to do what is essential for getting the most out of your night.

  • Increase your Stats: Some partygoers may require you to refine certain social abilities. Strengthen them, to become a better conversationalist.

  • Collect phone numbers: Befriended characters will want to keep in touch with you. The'll also provide you with helpful tips if you don't know how to proceed.

  • Multiple playthroughs: You might be able to gather some hints concerning some of the guests deepest secrets. Being observant is the key to uncovering the games multiple endings.

So get out there and have yourself an unforgettable night!

content_descriptors.notes: The game references and portrays the usage of legal substances like alcohol, given the house party setting. Although the use of these is not glorified, but presented in a balaced light, highlighting their danger and benefits.  Given the grounded setting featuring young adults, mild swearing as well as references to relationships and sexuality are present.

Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 14.04 or Steam OS 2.0 (64 bit)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OSX 10.10 or better. Not supported: macOS Big Sur 11.0 and later.
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGLR
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
